2024 CODE OF GEORGIA
Title 43 - PROFESSIONS AND BUSINESSES (§§ 43-1-1 — 43-51-15)
Chapter 26 - NURSES (§§ 43-26-1 — 43-26-65)
Article 1 - GEORGIA REGISTERED PROFESSIONAL NURSE PRACTICE ACT (§§ 43-26-1 — 43-26-13)
Section 43-26-1 - Short title

This article shall be known and may be cited as the "Georgia Registered Professional Nurse Practice Act."
